tasks.spec: Create a file named grok-smoke.txt in the current working directory. The file must contain exactly this text: grok works with ringer. A single trailing newline is acceptable. Do not add any other characters.
tasks.check: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; import sys; got=Path('grok-smoke.txt').read_text().rstrip(chr(10)); sys.exit(0 if got=='grok works with ringer' else 'content='+repr(got))"
tasks.verified: The check proves grok created grok-smoke.txt whose content is grok works with ringer after stripping at most trailing newlines. Run via engines/run-grok-smoke.sh to wipe the workdir first — otherwise a previous successful run can leave a stale grok-smoke.txt that masks a new failure.
